comments.author: dTal
comments.story: One-of-a-kind computer systems of which only one unit was ever produced
comments.why: Detailed, entertaining look at 1980s CGI-in-film techniques
comments.text: Missing from this list: the Foonly F1, used to create the animations in Tron (1982) and later to render the spaceship in Flight of the Navigator (1986) - of note as the first use of reflection mapping in a motion picture. I highly recommend this video on the making of Flight of the Navigator. Apart from being highly entertaining, it also goes into stunning detail on all the special effects, in particular how exactly one goes about putting CGI into film in the 1980s (as the narrator points out - Final Cut Pro hadn't been invented yet!). [VIDEO]
